title: Performance: message latency, streaming throughput, WG overhead
description: Measure and verify: chat latency <100ms (local), streaming throughput ≥ Wails baseline, WG tunnel overhead (latency + throughput comparison local vs remote), memory usage over 8h session, CPU usage during streaming, connection reconnection time <5s. Profile and optimize if needed (SSE batching, WG MTU).
acceptance_criteria: Streaming throughput: ≥ Wails baseline (measure and document)
WG overhead: latency and throughput comparison documented (local vs remote)
Memory: no leak over 8h session (Instruments profile)
Performance report: all metrics documented in .planning/PERFORMANCE.md
